Corée du Sud · 부산광역시 · 223 Toutes les Villes

Busan (부산광역시) — Guide de Voyage Corée du Sud : Que Voir, Accès & Gastronomie

Haeundae & Gwangalli Beaches, Gamcheon Culture Village, Haedong Yonggungsa Temple, Jagalchi Fish Market & BIFF Square. KTX from Seoul in 2h 15m to Busan Station; Gimhae International Airport (PUS); Busan Metro Lines 1–4.

RégionBusan (부산광역시)
Gare / Hub PrincipalBusan Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)
Toutes les Villes223

Accès & Transports

KTX from Seoul in 2h 15m to Busan Station; Gimhae International Airport (PUS); Busan Metro Lines 1–4.

Gastronomie & Spécialités Locales

  • Dwaeji gukbap (pork soup)
  • Milmyeon (cold wheat noodles)
  • Jagalchi raw seafood (hoe)
  • Ssiat hotteok
  • Eomuk (Busan fish cake)
